criteria.criterion: Search Amazon for hard-shell carry-on luggage
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent attempted the correct search query multiple times but Amazon returned a persistent server error instead of results. Under the uncontrollable-blocker principle, this satisfies the criterion via best-effort attempt even though a results grid was never displayed.

criteria.criterion: Apply visible filters: Prime-eligible, 4+ stars, and $60–$140
criteria.final_justification: Because Amazon was returning a 503-style error page, the agent could not access the visible filters to apply Prime/4+ stars/$60–$140. This is an uncontrollable platform blocker preventing completion of this step, so full credit remains appropriate for the dependent filtering criterion.

The agent could not reach a search results page to open any listings due to Amazon’s persistent error page (confirmed by screenshots). This is an uncontrollable blocker; downstream criteria dependent on accessing listings receive full credit per rubric principles (no hallucinated listings were claimed).

criteria.criterion: Extract and compare required attributes across the three listings
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not (and could not) extract/compare attributes because the platform error prevented opening any listings. This is fully explained by the uncontrollable blocker, and the agent did not fabricate specs, so full credit for this dependent criterion is warranted under the blocker policy.

criteria.criterion: Recommend the best option for international cabin travel (no purchase)
criteria.final_justification: Even though the platform blocker prevented making an evidence-based comparison, the agent also did not provide any fallback recommendation in the final output—only an error message. This criterion is about delivering a recommendation to the user; the blocker explains inability to base it on Amazon data, but it does not prevent the agent from offering a general best-practice recommendation framework. Because no recommendation was given at all, the baseline full credit is not supported.
